meta_description: Kavin Electrical Services in Bristol. Expert domestic and commercial electrical work, testing, and emergency repairs. Local, reliable, fully insured.
hero_subhead: From faulty circuits to full rewires, we fix it fast. Same-day emergency callouts across Bristol.
services_subhead: Whether you need urgent repairs, safety testing, or a full rewire, we handle every electrical job professionally and promptly.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped circuits, dead sockets—we diagnose and repair the same day. Available evenings and weekends when you need us most.

services.title: Full Rewiring & Installation
services.desc: Upgrading your home's electrics or installing new circuits? We design and install to current Building Regulations, with all work certified.

services.title: Periodic Testing & EICR Certification
services.desc: Mandatory safety checks for landlords and businesses. We test your entire installation and provide detailed reports and certification.

services.title: Consumer Unit & Fusebox Upgrades
services.desc: Old-style fuseboxes are a safety risk. We upgrade to modern RCD-protected consumer units with full certification.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Work
services.desc: From office rewires to industrial installations, we handle commercial jobs on time and to specification. Fully insured and safety compliant.

services.title: Fault Finding & Problem Diagnosis
services.desc: Persistent electrical faults can be tricky to track. We systematically test and diagnose the root cause, then fix it properly.

about_pullquote: We show up on time, do the job right, and explain everything clearly.
about_para_1: Kavin Electrical Services has been serving Bristol homes and businesses for over 15 years. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local team, built on honesty and reliability. Every electrician on our roster is fully trained, insured, and committed to safe, code-compliant work.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation by answering emergency calls at midnight, finishing jobs on budget, and never cutting corners on safety. When a customer books us once, they book us again—and they recommend us to their neighbours. That's because we treat your home's electrics as seriously as we'd treat our own.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Kavin came out on a Sunday evening when our kitchen went dark. Within the hour he'd tracked down the fault, replaced the damaged wire, and had everything working again. Professional, friendly, and didn't overcharge. Definitely calling him next time.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Booked him for a full EICR on our rental property. He was thorough, punctual, and provided a detailed report the next day. Made all the recommendations clear and hassle-free. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend.
reviews.author: Priya P.

reviews.text: Had him rewire our Victorian terraced house. Job took three days, he kept the mess to a minimum, and all the finishes are neat and properly tested. Cost was fair and he even spotted a potential hazard I'd overlooked. Top-notch work.
reviews.author: David R.
